value.message: Opting-in to ServiceNow® Benchmarks gives you instant access to your service management Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and comparative insights relative to industry averages of your peers. It also enables your anonymized usage data to be included in the global data aggregation.

This data is automatically refreshed so you always have access to the last six months of benchmarks data. ServiceNow® ensures the protection of benchmark data by employing identical policies, procedures, tools, and techniques that are used to safeguard your instance(s).

Opting out from ServiceNow Benchmarks means that you will no longer have access to benchmarking information for your instance. Your usage data will also be removed from the Benchmarks dataset going forward.
Your company can rejoin the ServiceNow Benchmarks service by clicking ‘Opt-in’ button on the Benchmarks setup page.
Please take a moment to tell us why you are opting out
Benchmarks provides the ability to analyze and compare the trends of the opted KPIs against the peers and industry top performers.
Assign different roles based on their respective access requirements.
